titleEn: Pofang (破防): When Your Emotional Defense Breaks — China's Most Versatile Emotion Word
summaryEn: Pofang, from gaming slang for 'breaking through defense', now means being emotionally overwhelmed — moved to tears, furious, or simply not okay.
emotionEquivalentEn: my defenses broke / I'm not okay (emotionally)

symbolLayer.explanation: 电子游戏术语（攻破防御值）的泛化：把数值化的战斗词汇移植到情感领域
symbolLayer.explanationEn: A generalized gaming term (breaking through defense values): combat vocabulary transplanted onto the emotional sphere.

origin: 起源于 MOBA 类游戏（英雄联盟等）的「防御塔/防御值」机制，2019-2020 年在弹幕文化中出圈
originEn: Originated in MOBA games (League of Legends etc.) as 'defense tower / defense value'; broke out via danmu culture in 2019-2020.
usage: 双性情绪词：① 被感动到破防（泪目）② 被气到破防（愤怒）③ 自嘲破防（心态崩了）；上下文决定极性
usageEn: A dual-polarity emotion word: moved to tears, outraged, or having a mental breakdown; context decides the polarity.
commonMisreading: 英文直译「break defense」会让读者误以为仍在谈游戏；它已是纯情绪词
commonMisreadingEn: Literal 'break defense' makes readers think it's still about games; it's now a pure emotion word.

memeLineage.event: MOBA 游戏「防御塔/防御值」术语，「破防」指攻破防御
memeLineage.eventEn: MOBA 'defense tower / value' term; 'pofang' means breaking defense

memeLineage.event: B 站弹幕文化出圈，「破防了」成为常见弹幕
memeLineage.eventEn: Bilibili danmu culture spreads it; 'pofang le' becomes a common comment

memeLineage.event: 双极情绪词定型：感动破防 / 愤怒破防 / 心态破防
memeLineage.eventEn: Dual-polarity emotion word forms: moved / furious / breakdown

memeLineage.event: 主流媒体标题开始使用「破防」，海外中文社区开始转译
memeLineage.eventEn: Mainstream headlines adopt 'pofang'; overseas Chinese communities translate it

memeLineage.event: 英语社区借用「pofang」描述情绪冲击
memeLineage.eventEn: English communities borrow 'pofang' for emotional shock
